text_block_list.text:
Her brilliant showing in the Fantasy 
Stakes directly influenced her popularity 
going into the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan, you have overwhelming 
support today, and people are calling you 
the 'star of the show'...!?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am today's star, Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Your job is to burn the image of Aston 
Machan into your eyes before going home. 
Enjoy it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! Meaning today's winner is Aston 
Machan as well...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

Camera flashes erupt at her confident 
remarks. And just then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't you go forgetting about me!

My attention was completely stolen away by 
the Umamusume who suddenly barged in.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall, is she the one who barely 
squeezed in?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: If I remember right... it's Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh! Shut up about barely making it or 
whatever! Who cares about that crap!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming approval rating? Aston 
Machan, the protagonist? Hah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You guys just don't know it yetâ the 
true strength of me, the strongest 
Umamusume in history!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, peel your eyes wide open and 
watch closely! I'm gonna show you the 
coolest race ever!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your only job today is to bask in the 
glorious presence of Lady Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The one who's gonna win is me!
(Flash flash flash!)

Leaving those words behind, Vodka spun on 
her heel and dashed briskly toward the 
racetrack, disappearing into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
... Look at him getting all hyped up. What 
an idiot.

An impassioned declaration out of nowhere. 
The rumor even reached the spectator 
stands—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see this Umamusume News? 
Vodka's formal declaration of war against 
Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The one that just came out? Yeah, I saw 
it! It's the one that goes 'I'm the one 
who's gonna win!', right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She seemed completely fired up! I might 
actually get my hopes up a little...!

Naturally, all eyes were drawn toward 
Vodka as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Guh. Grrrr...! Stop, stop... gah, 
alright!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No good, I'm still shaking.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not tremblin'.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're shaking, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm not shaking, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh, look at you being so pathetic! 
You talk big like that, and now you're 
chickening out? So lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't call me lame, idiot! It's not like 
I'm chickening out on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, I'm not scared at all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...If I were in the crowd, watching an 
underdog Umamusume win would be the 
coolest thing ever."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It makes me want to see her next race, 
and look forward to her Classic year 
campaign as well."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Some unknown Umamusume picked from the 
lottery? Isn't that great? It's the 
ultimate setup!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...The best...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Now I'm gonna knock 'em dead just like I 
said! Nothing's cooler than that, right?! 
Am I right?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, I'm off! Keep your eyes wide 
open and watch me, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, what a handful.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Good friends.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's one thing, and this is 
another. Today, you're just gonna have to 
be uncool Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't have to be lovely. That's just 
what racing is."
